method.bridge: one to_thread worker per block; execute + fetchall timed per statement
method.order: driver rotation per repeat; direct/bridge pair order reversed on odd repeats
method.scope: one caller, explicit open transactions, warm caches, SELECT only, no engine write
method.excluded: connection setup, warmup, validation after timer, outer to_thread dispatch
method.limitations: same process clock across threads; no affinity; no concurrent callers; p99 includes OS scheduling tails
